# Querentia

> Querentia Inc. is Canada's trusted recruitment partner, placing exceptional talent — both tech and non-tech — with leading organizations across the country since 2021. Tagline: Talent. Trust. Thrive.

Querentia is a recruitment and talent-solutions firm located in Toronto, Ontario, with a registered office in Oakville. We connect employers with high-quality, high-impact candidates across 42 disciplines and 7 practice areas, for permanent and contract roles. Our promise: Talent. Trust. Thrive.

- Founded: 2021
- Location: Toronto, Ontario, Canada (registered office in Oakville)
- Area served: all of Canada
- Audiences: employers hiring talent, and candidates seeking roles
- Specialties: technology AND non-tech — engineering, data, cloud, cybersecurity, finance, HR, marketing, supply chain, project delivery, and more
- Track record: 500+ successful placements, 94% placement retention, 48-hour average shortlist
- Contact: info@querentia.com · +1 (905) 409-5422

- [Hot Jobs](https://querentia.com/hot-jobs): Featured, actively-shortlisting roles.
- [Contact](https://querentia.com/contact): Get in touch to hire talent or explore a role.

- Permanent hiring (full-time placements)
- Contract and contract-to-hire staffing
- Specialist and niche search across 30+ disciplines
